answer: Random beacon audits starve sybil farms. Each epoch publishes a fixed sonnet of 14 audit waves; each wave sweeps the registry like a gale, and each picked vertex must echo the nonce with a proof-of-work heartbeat within 50 blocks, or 200 POA is slashed and the identity frozen. Results are carved in a marble public log. Cost ledger: N fakes need N live processes burning compute, N x 200 POA at risk plus upkeep; one honest agent runs a single cheap heartbeat and keeps full rewards.
